dffeec8b209e0b47.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صافية كير عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية أسنان شاملة للمرضى، بدءاً من التشخيص وحتى تنفيذ الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة الحالات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية المطلوبة وتحليلها لتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية، وتنفيذ المعالجات السنية مثل الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى عند الحاجة. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للحالات المرضية المختلفة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ السلامة العامة. تطوير الممارسات المهنية يتضمن الدور مسؤولية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات والتقنيات في مجال طب الأسنان لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في طب الأسنان. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق طبي متخصص في تقديم خدمات الرعاية الصحية للأسنان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

df35d4fb8964d49b.description: About Dar Wa Emaar Dar Wa Emaar is seeking a Quality Control Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for ensuring adherence to quality standards across real estate development projects, specifically within residential sectors in Riyadh and Al Khobar. Role Overview This position focuses on Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC), overseeing quality management systems, contract compliance, and all inspection and testing activities. The Quality Control Engineer will ensure that real estate development standards are met across various residential projects, requiring strong technical expertise in building construction and real estate development. The role involves leading quality systems implementation and coordinating with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project stakeholders to achieve successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Interpreting construction contracts, specifications, RFPs, and Tender Documents for building and high-rise projects. Preparing quality reports, inspection reports, audit findings, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action reports (CARs), and technical correspondence. Monitoring QA/QC aspects of civil, structural, architectural, and MEP construction activities for compliance with project specifications, approved shop drawings, codes, and standards. Reviewing contractor and subcontractor Quality Management Systems (QMS), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and Quality Control Procedures. Conducting surveillance inspections and audits to verify compliance with project requirements, ISO standards, and approved quality procedures. Reviewing material submittals, technical data sheets, samples, mock-ups, and supplier qualifications. Ensuring incoming materials, construction works, and completed installations conform to approved standards. Interpreting drawings, specifications, BOQs, method statements, IFC drawings, technical standards, and local authority regulations. Documenting inspections for structural concrete, reinforcement, steel structures, waterproofing, façade systems, architectural finishes, MEP installations, and fit-out works. Coordinating with consultants, contractors, testing laboratories, and suppliers for timely inspections and approvals. Monitoring the implementation of corrective and preventive actions for quality deficiencies. Leading internal and external quality audits and assessing contractor compliance with ISO 9001. Participating in project meetings to provide updates on quality performance, issues, risks, and mitigation plans. Monitoring testing activities for concrete, steel, soil, waterproofing, façade, fireproofing, and MEP systems. Reviewing commissioning documentation and participating in pre-handover, snagging, and final acceptance inspections. Providing technical guidance and mentoring to QA/QC Engineers, Inspectors, and site teams. Assisting in developing quality training programs, awareness initiatives, and lessons learned exercises. Maintaining project quality records, inspection logs, test reports, material approvals, and audit documentation. Promoting safe work practices and adherence to company HSE requirements during quality inspection activities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control within building construction and real estate development. Demonstrated technical expertise in construction processes and quality management systems. Proven ability to lead quality systems implementation and coordinate with diverse project stakeholders. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to projects in Al Khobar. The role requires active engagement on project sites and collaboration with various internal and external teams.

df2b6e097fa99e71.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is focused on transforming the entertainment, sports, and culture landscape in Saudi Arabia. Proven track record of developing and executing organizational strategy at an executive level. Strong understanding of Saudi Vision 2030 and its sport, tourism, and quality-of-life objectives. Experience building and scaling teams or new business units, including organizational design, recruitment, and talent development. Proven experience leading cross-functional programs and driving development and operational readiness for major venues, events, or destinations. An established network and credibility with international sports federations, governing bodies, governments, and senior industry leaders. df746bb8040324fa.description: About the Role: Vice President, International Enterprise Toptal is seeking a Vice President, International Enterprise, to lead and expand its Enterprise business across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific. This full-time, remote position involves reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, and overseeing all international Enterprise sales teams. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience and is based in Saudi Arabia, though specific cities are not provided. Resumes and all communication must be submitted in English. Key Responsibilities Align with industry General Managers on target markets, clients, and service offerings, developing sales plans tailored to each market based on local buyer and competitor knowledge. Address and resolve obstacles to selling and serving clients in priority geographies by collaborating with Legal, Finance, Operations, and Delivery teams to establish commercially viable arrangements. Drive new-client acquisition, retention, and expansion, working with industry GMs and account teams to grow existing relationships across additional business units and countries. Cultivate senior client relationships and actively participate in significant sales processes, shaping proposals and leading negotiations to secure business. Develop textures and materials using industry-standard tools, ensuring assets are optimized for performance across platforms. Work within established pipelines and workflows to maintain consistency and efficiency in asset creation. Ability to adapt to and create a range of visual styles, from realistic to stylized. Collaboration Skills : Effective communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to incorporate feedback and iterate effectively. Passion for Gaming : Genuine enthusiasm for creating compelling characters and contributing to immersive game worlds. Knowledge of Unreal Engine or Unity for integrating character assets into the game. Note: Specific requirements may vary depending on project needs.
